objectives.definition: Percentage of eligible, successfully measured grid cells ranking in positions 1-3 for a priority keyword.
objectives.success_rule: minimum target met for at least 3 priority keywords in two consecutive monthly runs
guardrails: same grid and settings across comparisons

objectives.definition: GA4 organic sessions attributed to Burlington, Halton Region, or Hamilton using consented, aggregate geography.
objectives.success_rule: rolling 28-day value is at least 1.40 times the locked baseline
guardrails: do not infer individual IP location

objectives.definition: Unique consented inquiries meeting the CRM qualification rubric and containing an attributable local source or declared local need.
objectives.success_rule: at least 10 qualified local leads in a calendar month with source coverage at or above 90 percent
guardrails: retain no raw personal data in reports

objectives.definition: New, independently verifiable branded mentions from relevant local media, organizations, events, or partners.
objectives.source: Search Console branded queries and evidence-linked mention register
objectives.success_rule: at least two earned local mentions and a non-negative branded-query trend versus baseline
guardrails: archive evidence URL and observation time

global_stop_conditions: Google Business Profile warning or suspension risk
production action without bound human approval
